subject: Control narrative & artifact crosswalk — inference cache and KV isolation for NovaNet
messages:
From: Alex Chen <alex.chen@novanet.com>
To: Priya Natarajan <priya_natarajan@redwood.com>
Cc: security@novanet.com
Date: Wed, 26 May 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: CSA runtime control crosswalk — cache/KV questions

Hi Priya,

Thanks for taking this on. Our CSA assessment team has a handful of targeted questions related to caching and KV-layer isolation in your hosted inference offering — we are filling a CAIQ spreadsheet and flagged a few controls that we can't map from the docs we have. Specifically:

- CSA-INF-07 / CSA-INF-09 (runtime caching behavior and tenant separation). We need:
  * A short control narrative that explains how Redwood's inference cache works across requests and tenants (what is cached, eviction policy, whether cache is shared across customers).
  * Concrete artifacts: configuration screenshot showing tenant-scoped cache namespace, an example log extract showing cache hits/misses tied to customer IDs (sanitized), and an excerpt of the retention policy for KV/cache telemetry.

- Evidence format: we're ok with zipped artifacts or a Drive link. Target delivery for our window is EOD next Wednesday (2027-06-02).

I'm attaching the CAIQ spreadsheet with our highlighted rows. Can you confirm owners and ETA?

Thanks,
Alex
Security Assessment Lead
NovaNet

[Attachment: NovaNet-CAIQ-spreadsheet.xlsx]

From: Priya Natarajan <priya_natarajan@redwood.com>
To: Alex Chen <alex.chen@novanet.com>
Cc: Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.com>, Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 26 May 2027 11:05:00 -0700
Subject: Re: CSA runtime control crosswalk — cache/KV questions

Alex — thanks for the clear ask and the spreadsheet. We can cover those items. High-level plan:

1) Control narratives: Marcus will draft concise narrative language for CSA-INF-07 / CSA-INF-09 explaining caching semantics and tenant isolation guarantees.
2) Artifacts: Marcus + Kimberly will pull screenshots (console config) and sanitized log snippets. Kimberly will confirm retention windows and link to our telemetry retention policy.
3) Packaging: I will bundle everything into a ZIP and upload to the Drive link you provided, plus send over a small cover note describing redactions/obfuscation.

Owners: Marcus (control narrative + config screenshot), Kimberly (log extracts + retention policy), Priya (packaging & delivery).

Can you confirm the requested fields in the sheet are the ones you need (we saw a few related sub-controls flagged)? If anything else is urgent (e.g., proof-of-isolation tests), let us know and we can prioritize.

Will return with an owner status update by EOD.

—Priya

Marcus Lin

Redwood Inference

From: Priya Natarajan <priya_natarajan@redwood.com>
To: Alex Chen <alex.chen@novanet.com>
Cc: Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.com>, Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.com>, security@novanet.com
Date: Thu, 27 May 2027 08:30:00 -0700
Subject: Re: CSA runtime control crosswalk — cache/KV questions

Alex — thanks for the patience. Attached is the compiled package for the CSA rows you flagged. Summary below and artifacts are in the attached ZIP and in the Drive folder: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1a2B3cNovaNetCAIQ

Executive summary (2–3 bullets):
- Isolation: Redwood's runtime uses tenant-scoped cache namespaces; no cross-tenant cache key collisions are possible. The cache namespace is enforced at the server process level and validated in CI.
- Retention & telemetry: Cache/KV access logs are retained for 90 days in the telemetry cluster; sanitized samples are provided. Eviction is LRU with TTLs configurable per-model scope (default 8 hours).
- Controls mapping: CSA-INF-07 mapped to our design doc + cache-eviction-policy.md; CSA-INF-09 mapped to config screenshot (kv-isolation-config.png) + sanitized log sample.

Attachments included in evidence bundle:
- evidence-bundle-20270526.zip (contains: cache-log-sample.txt [sanitized], kv-isolation-config.png, cache-eviction-policy.md, retention-policy-excerpt.pdf)

Redactions: We replaced internal tenant IDs with redacted tokens and removed any request payloads in the log sample. The cover note in the ZIP explains the substitutions.

If you need a live demo of the tenant-isolation test, Marcus can run a live session next week.

Best,
Priya Natarajan
Director, Trust & Identity
Redwood Inference
Phone: (415) 555-0192

[Attachment: evidence-bundle-20270526.zip]
